title: Task list
description: The task list page at / (add form, open tasks newest first with done checkbox, edit link and delete button, Done section with reopen, empty state, counts in headings) and the edit page at /tasks/[id]/edit (prefilled form, Save redirects to /, Cancel link, validation errors re-render, unknown id is notFound()). Server actions in src/app/actions.ts and src/app/tasks/[id]/edit/actions.ts call one repository function each and revalidatePath. Client components add-task-form, task-list, edit-task-form with useActionState. e2e/tasks.spec.ts. docs/current/how/tasks.md (diagram: task-flow), and setup.md/README.md updated where facts changed. Expected shape: one warm-chain of three ticks (list + add → done/reopen/delete → edit). Source of truth: docs/thoughts/2026-09-17-increment-01-task-basics.md sections 'On screen', 'App', 'Documentation added' and 'Definitions of done → Epic 2'.
acceptance_criteria: A1 pnpm check green; A2 pnpm test:e2e green; A4 coverage floor holds. e2e/tasks.spec.ts proves: empty state text on a fresh db; adding 'Buy milk' shows it first under 'Open (1)' and clears the form; empty title shows 'Title is required.' and adds nothing; 'Mark done: Buy milk' moves it under 'Done (1)' struck through; 'Reopen: Buy milk' moves it back; 'Delete: Buy milk' removes it and the empty state returns; the edit page changes title to 'Buy oat milk' and notes to '2 litres' and the list shows both; empty title on edit shows the error and changes nothing; /tasks/999999/edit is a 404. docs/current/how/tasks.md exists with the task-flow diagram and is listed; A3 pnpm docs:check --strict green after close-out render. scripts/check-rules.test.ts still passes.
closed_reason: Completed: task list page, done/reopen/delete, edit page, 10 e2e + 55 vitest green; retro in ia-cycles/task-list.md
